insights.text: People say it's patched. Must have just been on my end but i was able to do the extraction bug on my 2nd run today 9/27. Started off normal farming stuff and left after 1st extraction and when i came back the 2nd one was there and then all the rest after i left.
I just had this happen to me on my 2nd attempt today 9/27. Can't get it to happen again.
